basic_info.description:
Unlock the potential of this 1-bedroom house, nestled in a prime location just half block from Ocean Avenue! This property is a contractors dream, offering endless possibilities for renovation and expansion.
Key Features:
Spacious Lot: 2,813 sq ft lot with ample outdoor space.
Fixer-Upper Opportunity: Bring your vision and transform this property to your own personal needs.
Bonus Garage Structure: A detached garage in the back offers the perfect canvas for an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or your desired project.
Prime Location: Enjoy the vibrant community at your doorstep! Steps away from shops and a variety of dining options. 
Excellent Transit Access: public transportation is just around the corner. The streetcar on Ocean Avenue connects you effortlessly to SF State University and SF City College.
Easy Commuting: Convenient access to Freeway 280 makes commuting a breeze.

This property is perfect for investors, DIY enthusiasts, or anyone looking to create their dream space in a desirable neighborhood. Dont miss this incredible opportunity!
